items.d: The question of leadership has once again come to the forefront of Bangladesh’s banking sector. A former governor of Bangladesh Bank recently drew attention to the shortage of suitably capable managing directors (MDs). The regulator has also introduced a Key Performance Indicator (KPIs) framework to assess their performance.

items.t: Protect children from the harms of social media
items.d: HC directive to form a committee to draft a usage policy is welcome

items.t: Car bomb destroys buildings in central Colombian city
items.d: A car bomb detonated in the central Colombian city of Villavicencio on Monday, destroying a local governor’s office and surrounding buildings, President Abelardo de la Espriella said.

items.t: Nato vows space defence after Russia nuclear satellite report
items.d: Nato chief Mark Rutte said Monday the alliance would defend against threats in space when asked about German media reports that Russia may be preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite.

items.t: India blocks London trip of CJP leader
items.d: A leader of India’s youth-led “Cockroach” movement has said he was prevented from leaving New Delhi to fly to Britain to deliver talks on the viral group’s protests.

items.t: Wars threaten food aid for 7.3m more people
items.d: World Food Programme (WFP) Executive Director Luke Lindberg warned on Monday that shipping chokepoints linked to wars in the Middle East and Ukraine could raise the agency’s costs by $727 million by mid-2027, threatening food aid for 7.3 million more people.

items.t: Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper hit for second time in less than a week
items.d: The tallest skyscraper in the Saudi capital was hit yesterday by an unspecified projectile, three witnesses told AFP, the second time in less than a week the building in Riyadh’s business district has been struck.

items.t: 14 countries ‘acknowledge’ ICJ ruling
items.d: The UK and 13 other countries on Monday “acknowledged” the top UN court’s ruling that Myanmar perpetrated genocide against its Rohingya minority as London announced new sanctions.
